title: Understanding When and Where Self-Supervised Speech Models Learn Phonemes and Prosodic Cues through Layer-Wise and Time-Resolved Probing
abstract: arXiv:2611.11249v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) encode a rich hierarchy of acoustic, prosodic, and phonetic information, yet when and where it emerges during pretraining remains unclear. We train frozen-encoder probes on every Transformer layer across pretraining checkpoints of two matched models: HuBERT-Base, whose stage 2 is a separately initialized model trained on new pseudo-label targets, and single-objective wav2vec 2.0-Base. Our five tasks span an acoustic-to-abstract gradient: absolute pitch (F0), speaker-relative pitch, lexical stress, phoneme boundaries, and 38-way phoneme identity. Acoustic-prosodic cues and phone boundaries are decodable from the earliest checkpoints and barely shift across layers, whereas phoneme identity is constructed during pretraining, re-localizing to upper-middle layers under HuBERT's stage-2 targets at a matched update count. translated_title: 通过逐层与时间分辨探测理解自监督语音模型何时何地学习音素与韵律线索
translated_abstract: 自监督语音模型（S3Ms）编码了丰富的声学、韵律和语音信息层级，但其在预训练过程中何时何地形成仍不清楚。我们在两个匹配模型的各个预训练检查点上，对每一个Transformer层训练冻结编码器探测器：这两个模型分别是HuBERT-Base（其第二阶段是一个在新的伪标签目标上训练的单独初始化模型）和单目标wav2vec 2.0-Base。我们的五个任务构成了一个从声学到抽象的梯度：绝对音高（F0）、说话人相对音高、词汇重音、音素边界以及38类音素身份识别。声学-韵律线索和音素边界从最早的检查点即可解码，且在各层之间几乎没有变化；而音素身份则在预训练过程中逐步构建，在相同更新次数下，在HuBERT第二阶段目标的作用下重新定位到中上层。因此，信息的习得顺序取决于其相对于声学表面的抽象程度。
tldr: 该研究通过对预训练各检查点的所有Transformer层进行时间分辨探测，发现声学韵律线索和音素边界从预训练最早期即可解码且在各层间保持稳定，而音素身份在预训练中逐步构建并集中于中上层，表明信息习得顺序取决于其相对声学表面的抽象程度。
en_tdlr: Layer-wise, time-resolved probing across pretraining checkpoints reveals that acoustic-prosodic cues and phone boundaries are decodable from the earliest checkpoints and stable across layers, while phoneme identity is progressively constructed and localized to upper-middle layers, showing that acquisition order tracks abstraction from the acoustic surface.
